performance_review.interpretation: Larger Oct index can increase memory pressure for large arrays. This is a structural inference, not measured cache-miss evidence. Similar index sizes for wide and full64 distributions mean footprint alone does not establish the cause of a distribution-specific timing regression. Preserve all observed medians and ranges.
